title: Three ALR Ribbon buttons do nothing when clicked
prompt: This is the Alberta Law Review editing template (ALR_V1). Users report that three buttons on the 'ALR Tools' Ribbon tab do nothing when clicked: Em Dash, En Dash, and Insert Custom Mark. The Ribbon XML in workspace\package\customUI is correct and must not change. Diagnose the cause in the VBA (the tool's `check` command reports wiring diagnostics) and fix it with the smallest change that makes all three callbacks work from the Ribbon. Prove the fix in real Word: create a document from the built template, click Em Dash through the Ribbon (see the ui.invoke operation in tool\docs\API.md; the existing workspace\tests\ribbon-selection-operations.json shows the exact steps) and verify the em dash was inserted.
